rituals.ritualText:
GAME
NUMBERS HAVE A HIDDEN DIRECTION

GOAL
Numbers may be sitting on an invisible line in your head.

ONE RULE
Which side feels more natural for 2 and which for 9?

PLAY
Flash numbers 1–9. Point left for small, right for large. Reverse it. Catch which mapping feels weirdly wrong.

TWIST
Catch the invisible left-right number habit.

WIN
Your brain quietly puts small and large numbers on an invisible left-right line.

MIND BEND
Abstract quantities can inherit physical direction.

SAFETY
Keep the sensory trick gentle and brief. Natural breathing only; stop if anything feels uncomfortable or more activating.
rituals.target_pattern: Small and large numbers being spatially associated with left and right
rituals.theory_backbone: SNARC effect; numerical cognition; spatial mapping
rituals.mechanism_fingerprint: Compare response fluency when small-versus-large numerical magnitudes are mapped to spatially congruent versus reversed response directions.
